name: semantic-options-object
description: Upstream turns listItems(limit) into listItems({ limit, offset }) and updates its callers; the change adds a new caller with the positional form, which now silently returns every item. Adapt the new caller.

plan.title: Item preview
plan.intent: Show the first two items as a comma-separated preview.

plan.title: Paginate listItems
plan.intent: listItems takes an options object { limit, offset } so pages can be fetched; update all callers.
